name: Trail Sense
description: Quest stops are looked for 15% further out, and new ground does 5% more against things, per rank.

name: Cartographer
description: One more ring of ground read round every new cell, per rank. Works once the fog is back on the map.

name: Pathfinder
description: The first 10 new cells of an outing pay double XP, per rank (10, then 20).

name: Far Wanderer
description: New cells more than 5 km from where the outing began pay 10% more XP, per rank.

name: Arcane Sight
description: A placed piece is 20% more likely to be a rune stone, per rank. Works once runes can be held.

name: Foresight
description: A rune does 6% more against things, per rank.

name: Ley Finder
description: A rune reaches 500 m further, per rank: 1.5 km, then 2 km.

name: Second Chance
description: One missed optional objective of a quest counts as done. Works from 0.7.0.

name: Second Wind
description: Once an outing passes 10 km (5 km on foot), the road does 10% more against things, per rank.

name: Mountainborn
description: Opens the summit quests, and height does 10% more against things.

name: Endurance
description: The XP for a long way pays 10% more, per rank.

name: Vanguard
description: Everything you do against elders and bounties does 10% more, per rank.

name: Archivist
description: The word does 8% more against things, per rank.

name: Rumour
description: Boxes pay 5% more coins, per rank.

name: Footnote
description: On an outing where you wrote a note, places found pay 20% more XP.

name: Historian
description: The word does 15% more against things at old and cultural places, per rank.
